headline: 32 arrested over Awami League procession in Gulshan
summary: Dhaka Metropolitan Police detained leaders and activists of the banned party and its associate bodies for participating in a rally in the capital.
details: Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) have arrested 32 leaders and activists of the Awami League and its associate bodies. The arrests followed a procession held in the capital's Gulshan area yesterday.

DMP Additional Deputy Commissioner Niaz Mehedi and Deputy Commissioner Akter Hossain confirmed the arrests. They stated that the case was filed with Gulshan Police Station under the Anti-Terrorism Act.
The government had banned all activities of the Awami League and its affiliated organisations on May 11 last year.
The ban was imposed following allegations of killings, genocide, crimes against humanity, and other grave offences during the July uprising.

headline_marked: PM launches [[three-month nationwide dengue prevention campaign]]
headline: PM launches three-month nationwide dengue prevention campaign
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman urges citizens to spend one hour weekly on cleaning to tackle mosquito breeding grounds.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman inaugurated the 'Dengue Prevention and Cleanliness Campaign-2026' at the South Plaza of the Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban. The three-month nationwide initiative aims to significantly reduce the spread of the disease through collective public effort.

The PM urged citizens to dedicate at least one hour every week to cleaning their homes, schools, colleges, workplaces, and surroundings. He emphasized that preventing mosquito breeding is the safest and easiest way to tackle dengue.

Tarique highlighted that discarded plastic, paper, and other waste can collect stagnant water, creating breeding grounds for mosquitoes. He also called for greater public awareness against the indiscriminate dumping of waste on roads and public places.

The Prime Minister called for the active participation of millions of young people, students, Scouts, BNCC members, and volunteers. He noted that with around 2.5 crore students and millions of youth, their collective action can bring about significant change.

Referring to the mass upsurge on August 5, 2024, the PM stated that the youth have already demonstrated their ability to bring about change and should now work together to rebuild the state and the country.

The campaign was jointly organised by the Ministry of Local Government and Dhaka North and South City Corporations, with various government ministers and city corporation administrators attending the inaugural programme.
